cells.gaps: No rule in force is found: a 2024 study of public-sector web teams reports no legal framework or guidelines (MAR-005). No delivery of accessible digital services by a government body is found.
cells.note: A study by the Mediator, the ONDH and the Secretariat of State for Social Inclusion, presented in March 2026, found 47.5% of public institutions offer inclusive digital solutions. A later yes answers the earlier ones, so 5.
